kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تُونُس or تُونِس • (tūnus or tūnis) f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Uncertain, but some possibilities are:
* Derived from a Berber root ens "to lie down", tansawt "to pass the night", thus "encampment".
* Related to the Phoenician goddess Tanit.
g: Tunis (the capital city, since 1159, and largest city of Tunisia)
